name: osc-mcp
description: FastMCP 3.4 Open Sound Control server — bidirectional OSC, MIDI-to-OSC bridge, OSCQuery/Zeroconf discovery, reactive triggers, Arazzo workflows, and per-app managers for Ableton Live (via AbletonOSC), TouchDesigner, VRChat, VCV Rack (via OSCelot), SuperCollider, Max/MSP, Resolume, QLab, Pure Data, OBS Studio WebSockets.

tools.name: get_midi_ports
tools.description: Retrieve lists of available physical/virtual MIDI inputs and outputs on the host.

tools.name: start_midi_bridge
tools.description: Start the bidirectional MIDI-to-OSC loopback bridge.

tools.name: stop_midi_bridge
tools.description: Stop the currently running MIDI-OSC Bridge.

tools.name: add_midi_mapping
tools.description: Add a dynamic CC or Note mapping rule to the running bridge.

tools.name: get_midi_mappings
tools.description: Retrieve all currently active MIDI and OSC mapping rules in the bridge.

tools.name: send_osc
tools.description: Send an OSC message to the specified address.

tools.name: start_osc_server
tools.description: Start an OSC server to receive incoming messages.

tools.name: stop_osc_server
tools.description: Stop a running OSC server and free the port.

tools.name: get_received_messages
tools.description: Get OSC messages received by a running OSC server.

tools.name: get_latest_message
tools.description: Get the most recent OSC message from a running server.

tools.name: get_osc_server_stats
tools.description: Get statistics about a running OSC server's message buffer.

tools.name: clear_osc_message_buffer
tools.description: Clear all messages from an OSC server's buffer.

tools.name: ableton_manager
tools.description: Ableton Live Manager - Professional DAW control.

tools.name: vrchat_manager
tools.description: VRChat Manager - Avatar, world, and input control.

tools.name: touchdesigner_manager
tools.description: TouchDesigner Manager - Comprehensive real-time visual programming control.

tools.name: vcv_manager
tools.description: VCV Rack Manager - modular synthesis control via OSCelot.

tools.name: osc_recorder_manager
tools.description: OSC Recorder Manager - Record and playback OSC message sequences.

tools.name: music_loader_manager
tools.description: Music Loader Manager - High-level orchestration for loading and playing music.

tools.name: music_orchestrator
tools.description: Music Orchestrator - High-level multi-step workflow automation.

tools.name: supercollider_manager
tools.description: SuperCollider Manager - Algorithmic composition and audio synthesis.

tools.name: maxmsp_manager
tools.description: Max/MSP Manager - Audio/visual programming control.

tools.name: resolume_manager
tools.description: Resolume Arena Manager - VJ software and live video mixing.

tools.name: audio_workflow_manager
tools.description: Audio Workflow Manager - Coordinate multi-application audio workflows.

tools.name: puredata_manager
tools.description: Pure Data Manager - Visual programming and audio processing.

tools.name: send_osc_message
tools.description: Send OSC message to target application with conversational guidance.

tools.name: start_osc_listener
tools.description: Start OSC server to receive messages.

tools.name: generate_osc_workflow
tools.description: Generate a complete OSC automation workflow using AI sampling.

tools.name: execute_osc_workflow
tools.description: Execute a generated OSC workflow with intelligent validation.

tools.name: test_osc_echo
tools.description: Test OSC functionality with conversational guidance and intelligent validation.

tools.name: list_arazzo_workflows
tools.description: List all available Arazzo mission descriptors in this server.

tools.name: oscquery_list_services
tools.description: List dynamically discovered OSCQuery devices on the local network.

tools.name: oscquery_get_parameters
tools.description: Retrieve full parameter tree for a discovered OSCQuery device.

tools.name: register_reactive_trigger
tools.description: Register an event action triggering an MCP tool when an OSC message matches a pattern.

tools.name: get_reactive_triggers
tools.description: Retrieve list of all active reactive trigger actions.

tools.name: remove_reactive_trigger
tools.description: Remove a reactive trigger action matching the specified pattern.

tools.name: trigger_vrchat_haptic_lfo
tools.description: Trigger VRChat haptic feedback modulated by an LFO waveform.

tools.name: set_vrchat_expression
tools.description: Set VRChat avatar Unified Expressions (face/eye tracking) parameters.

tools.name: show_active_mappings
tools.description: Display an interactive data table of active MIDI and reactive trigger mappings.

tools.name: show_discovered_devices
tools.description: Display an interactive data table of discovered OSCQuery devices on the network.

tools.name: show_recent_messages
tools.description: Display an interactive data table of recently received OSC messages on a port.

tools.name: show_available_workflows
tools.description: Display an interactive data table of available Arazzo automation workflows.

tools.name: obs_manager
tools.description: Control OBS Studio via OSC.

tools.name: qlab_manager
tools.description: Control Figure 53 QLab workspaces via OSC.

tools.name: scan_subnet_osc
tools.description: Scan a subnet prefix for active OSC ports.

tools.name: show_control_faders
tools.description: Display interactive faders and buttons to send immediate OSC values.

tools.name: show_osc_oscilloscope
tools.description: Display a simulated real-time oscilloscope tracking incoming/outgoing OSC activity intensity.

tools.name: save_workflow_descriptor
tools.description: Save a newly created workflow descriptor as an Arazzo YAML file.
